content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Head of the Project, CoE-UPD, SPA Delhi, for engagement of non-technical manpower for the Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning and Design, MoHUA, Govt. of India. The engagement is on contract basis and is project-based.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply in the prescribed application form for Non-Technical Positions. The form can be downloaded from the SPA Delhi application form (PDF) . Download the prescribed application form from the link given in the notice. Fill in the form completely, as incomplete applications are summarily rejected. Prepare a proper scanned copy of the complete application form along with self-attested copies of certificates, marks sheets, testimonials, etc. Email the scanned set to both [email protected] and [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent latest by 30 November 2026; applications received after the last date are summarily rejected. The notice does not give an email subject line or a postal address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: B.E/B.Tech in a relevant field in relevant subject from a recognized university with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Desirable: Proficiency in Soft Computing and Data Management. Essential: Senior Secondary Examination (12th Standard) or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Board. Essential: Typewriting speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer. Desirable: Working knowledge of MS Office and typing speed on computer. Desirable: Experience of handling processing/management/data entry, etc. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The remuneration is paid as stated above. No other allowance such as TA, DA, HRA or Medical is admissible. For field visits recommended by the Head of the Project, TA/DA will be paid as per the entitlement mentioned in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must enter into a contract with CoE-UPD, including a confidentiality clause, before being assigned any work. The initial tenure is 11 months from the date of engagement, which may be extended based on satisfactory performance and project requirements. Either party may terminate the engagement by giving one month's notice. The engagement is purely contractual and project-based; selected candidates have no right to claim regularization or permanent employment in the School of Planning and Architecture or any other authority. Candidates are entitled to 08 days of Casual Leave during the period of engagement, as per applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete application form (scanned copy). Self-attested copies of certificates, marks sheets, testimonials, etc. Original documents, to be produced at the time of verification if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized and eligible candidates are shortlisted for the selection process. For Data Entry Operator, a Skill Test (Typing Test) is conducted for shortlisted candidates to assess typing speed and computer proficiency. The prescribed speed is 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on a computer. Shortlisted candidates may also be called for personal interaction and verification of documents, and must produce original documents at verification. The final selection is based on the prescribed eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, relevant experience, performance in the Skill Test (where applicable) and personal interaction.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SPA Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 1 Junior Technical Assistant and 2 Data Entry Operator (D.E.O). The notice says the number may vary depending upon the requirement of the Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email latest by 30 November 2026. Applications received after the last date are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Junior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: B.E/B.Tech in a relevant field in relevant subject from a recognized university with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Proficiency in Soft Computing and Data Management is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The 12th Standard or equivalent from a recognized University/Board, plus typewriting speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Junior Technical Assistant gets Rs.50,000 per month and Data Entry Operator gets Rs.30,000 per month, both consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. Will TA, DA or HRA be paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No. No allowance such as TA, DA, HRA or Medical is admissible, except TA/DA for field visits recommended by the Head of the Project.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed application form, fill it in, and email a scanned copy with self-attested certificates and marks sheets to [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants are shortlisted; Data Entry Operator candidates take a typing Skill Test, and shortlisted candidates may be called for personal interaction and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job and how long is the tenure?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual and project-based, with an initial tenure of 11 months that may be extended. Selected candidates cannot claim regularization or permanent employment.

faq.question: Q10. How much leave is allowed during the engagement?
faq.answer: Candidates are entitled to 08 days of Casual Leave during the period of engagement, as per applicable rules.
